_comment: VO source of truth for the audio scripts (mirrors brief/02-script.md v2). `text` = the script line (word list for captions/sync); `tts` = what is sent to ElevenLabs when it differs (pronunciation only: D-A-O spelled, NEAR as the word 'Near' so v4 never spells it N-E-A-R). Word order and count must stay identical between text and tts.

lines.text: Every group trip has a money problem.
…then spends weeks chasing everyone to pay up.
Split apps just keep score. Shared accounts hand one person all the money.
What if the money lived right in the group chat?
Meet Pot. … Group chat money that follows its own rules.
Start a Pot for the trip, and set the rules in plain words.
Drop the link in the chat. Friends join with Google and chip in their share. No wallet. No seed phrase. No gas.
Small spends approve themselves. Eighty-four dollars for groceries? Pot checks the rules… approved, and paid back in seconds.
Bigger spends go to the group. The three-hundred-dollar boat trip needs two of three… so Leo approves, right from a notification.
When the trip's over, close the Pot. Everyone gets their fair share back.
Under the hood, every Pot is a Sputnik DAO on NEAR. Its rules are enforced on-chain, not by a person. Every action is gasless. And no one can take money out alone.
